headline: The FDA issued a second Complete Response Letter on October 16, 2025 for DRL_RI, Dr. Reddy's proposed biosimilar to Rituxan (rituximab), citing deficiencies from a pre-license facility inspection. Dr. Reddy's did not announce the letter on its date.
pdufa_note: The FDA's Complete Response Letter for BLA 761376 is dated October 16, 2025 and names the product as DRL_RI (FDA CRL file). It is addressed to Dr. Reddy's Laboratories SA in care of Parexel International. The letter says the application was a complete response to the FDA's April 19, 2024 action letter (that letter's text), and that after a pre-license inspection of a facility listed in the application the FDA conveyed deficiencies on a Form 483 that the facility should answer before the company responds; product quality deficiencies are redacted. Dr. Reddy's filed no release with the SEC on Form 6-K from October 14 through October 24, 2025 that announces this letter, and its second-quarter results filed October 24, 2025 do not mention it. The FDA approved BLA 761376 on July 31, 2026 as Zimrixby (rituximab-cdxx), and its approval letter says the resubmission of February 2, 2026 responded to the October 16, 2025 action letter (FDA approval letter). Because the letter was not announced on its date, this page is left out of the run-up study. No PDUFA goal date is stated, so no early or late margin is given. A Complete Response Letter means the FDA will not approve the application in its present form; the sponsor can resubmit.
source_label: FDA Complete Response Letter, BLA 761376, October 16, 2025
h1: DRL_RI rituximab biosimilar (RDY) FDA Complete Response Letter: Oct 16, 2025

indication: Proposed biosimilar to Prolia and Xgeva (denosumab)
headline: Dr. Reddy's disclosed on December 31, 2025 that the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter on its BLA for AVT03, a proposed denosumab biosimilar developed by Alvotech, citing observations from an inspection of Alvotech's Reykjavik manufacturing facility; the FDA's letter is dated December 30, 2025.
pdufa_note: Dr. Reddy's stock exchange disclosure dated December 31, 2025, filed with the SEC on Form 6-K that day, says its subsidiary Dr. Reddy's Laboratories SA received a Complete Response Letter from the FDA for its BLA for AVT03 (denosumab), and that the CRL refers to the observations from a pre-license inspection of Alvotech's Reykjavik manufacturing facility (Dr. Reddy's disclosure, SEC Exhibit 99.1). The FDA's released letter on BLA 761471 is dated December 30, 2025 and names the product as AVT03 (the letter's text). It says the FDA conveyed deficiencies on a Form 483 after a pre-license inspection of a facility listed in the application, asks for revised labeling, and agrees that a REMS will be needed for AVT03 if it is approved, because of the risk of severe hypocalcemia in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease. Alvotech's annual report on Form 20-F for 2025 states that the FDA issued Complete Response Letters on the BLAs for AVT03, AVT05 and AVT06 (Alvotech 20-F). The disclosure states no PDUFA goal date, so no early or late margin is given. A Complete Response Letter means the FDA will not approve the application in its present form; the sponsor can resubmit.
h1: AVT03 denosumab biosimilar (RDY) FDA Complete Response Letter: Dec 31, 2025
